# CANDIDATE: WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE_3DTE

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Extending the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE signal to 3DTE (instead of max 2DTE) will capture J's actual 3DTE anchor day trades (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) with reduced theta decay versus 0DTE, preserving directional edge while avoiding same-day gamma crush. The structural DTE lift hypothesis holds: longer DTE reduces theta bleed on entry premium, allowing runners to develop without premature stop-outs.

## Mechanism

- Trigger: identical to WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE — `vwap_continuation` signal fires (same bar logic)
- Contract selection: same strike (ITM-2) as base 0DTE, but expiry = 3 calendar days out (Friday weekly if available, else nearest weekly)
- Exit: identical -8%/+30% (premium-based) as WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE, managed by chandelier profit-lock (+5% arm, 15% trail)
- Position sizing: adjusted for higher premium (3DTE ITM-2 ~2.5× 0DTE ITM-2 premium) → qty = floor( base_qty * (0DTE_premium / 3DTE_premium) ) to maintain constant risk
- Key constraint: only fires when 3DTE weekly expiry has sufficient liquidity (OI ≥ 500, spread ≤ $0.12) per risk-rules liquidity gate

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** 3DTE ITM-2 avg premium ~$2.50 (vs 0DTE ~$1.00) → qty reduction to ~40% of 0DTE size. $25K+ account required for full headline P&L; $1K paper realizes ~16% of headline.
2. **Sample bias:** Based on WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE analysis (n=~150 trades over 16 months). Extending to 3DTE reduces sample size by ~60% (liquidity filters). Overfit risk: moderate — same signal, only DTE variable changes.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window pending)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days not yet validated with 3DTE OPRA fills)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: 5/04 adverse gap against position (3DTE less sensitive to intraday gaps but still vulnerable to overnight news)
   - Max drawdown: estimated -$1,200 (vs 0DTE -$950) due to larger swing potential in weekly options
   - Blow-up scenario: Volatility crush (IV drop) on thesis failure day → 3DTE extrinsic decay accelerates losses vs 0DTE
6. **Concentration:** Top-3 J winner days projected to contribute ~52% of 3DTE P&L (vs 48% for 0DTE WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE) — similar concentration profile.
